content: Resilience4j is the de facto standard resilience library for Spring Boot 3 (Hystrix has been in maintenance mode since 2019 and is absent from Boot 3 dependency management). Provides CircuitBreaker, Retry, RateLimiter, Bulkhead, TimeLimiter as composable annotations; aspect order is Retry(CircuitBreaker(RateLimiter(TimeLimiter(Bulkhead(Method))))). Common starting config: sliding-window-size=20, failure-rate-threshold=50%, wait-duration-in-open-state=10s.
